commit_message: Render Native 2D sprites through ordered GPU batches
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Adds a dedicated instanced Native 2D sprite pass inside WorldRenderer with stable layer/order/entity sorting, compatible texture/material/sampler batching, alpha/premultiplied/additive blending, nearest/linear sampling, project PPU/filter defaults, and shared decoded-texture GPU residency.
